summary: Depth on an NSE equity from 1502 events whose book is the Bids/Asks lists in Touchline: five levels a side, then both lists empty, which clears the book.

notes: RMoney's payloads are put into the template's shape first (families/xts/streaming/variants.rs, XtsHooks::payload_variants): the instrument under any of its key spellings, the segment by name, each book side from the root, Touchline, or BidInfo/AskInfo (a single level object or a list), a book from either side.

Audit R107-09: a side RMoney sends empty, wherever its web adapter looks for one, clears it, so the book the client sees empties (families/xts/streaming/variants.rs side). The web loses this clear: its adapter adds the depth key only when a side has levels (rmoney_adapter.py:957), so its Depth frame carries no book.

deviations.reason: XTS sent average_price in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode (lead decision, night of 9 Nov).

XTS sent last_quantity in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode (lead decision, night of 9 Nov).

The 1502 event carries no LowerCircuitLimit; the web sends lower_circuit 0 for it (message.get('LowerCircuitLimit', 0)), the desktop leaves it out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out).

The web sends XTS's LastTradedTime as it comes, seconds since 1980-01-01 IST (1478686530 is 2026-11-09 10:15:30 IST): a wrong unit, since feed timestamps are Unix epoch milliseconds (docs/prompt/websockets-format.md). The desktop sends the trade time in milliseconds (1794199530000).
The 1502 event carries no OpenInterest; the web sends oi 0 for it (message.get('OpenInterest', 0)), the desktop leaves it out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out).

XTS sent total_buy_quantity in the 1502 event's Touchline; this web adapter's Depth data drops it (mode 3 keeps ltp, ltt, volume, OHLC, oi, the circuits and the book), the desktop's Depth frame keeps it: data the broker sent, lost from a mode (lead decision, night of 9 Nov).

The 1502 event carries no UpperCircuitLimit; the web sends upper_circuit 0 for it (message.get('UpperCircuitLimit', 0)), the desktop leaves it out (docs: a field the stream does not carry is left out).

The partial does not repeat close; the web keeps no quote and sends 0 for it (.get(x, 0)), the desktop keeps the instrument's last value of it (feed/bridge/snapshot.rs; audit appendix item 1): lost data on the web.

RMoney sent this book's sides empty; the web's adapter adds the depth key only when a side has levels (if bids or asks), so its Depth frame carries no book and the client keeps showing the old one: the clear is lost. The desktop sends the empty book {buy: [], sell: []} (decisions: a book cleared after one existed is an empty book; web drops the key: web defect, the clear is lost; audit R107-09).
